correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration from definitions: 96 GC-balanced four-mers, 8 self-RC, 44 two-word RC orbits, 4 internally swap-conflicting orbits, 40 eligible orbit vertices, 100 conflict edges, and five connected components. Direct enumeration of every component subset gives independent-set maxima (2,3,2,3,1) with counts (3,12,3,12,4). This proves 22 and 5184; a 22-word construction passes every pairwise shadow test. A separate composition-first recursive solver confirms these outputs and the comparison 25. All scripts are supplied.

value.rationale: Exact capacity plus complete labeled extremizer count for the conjunction of fixed half-GC composition, Watson–Crick strand pairing, exclusion of self-paired strands, and a physically motivated adjacent-transposition edit.
